BACONC PILIPINAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dflq.qovph OILG OPINION NO. JAN 10 HON. VINCENT ALEXES A. PADEN, MD Sangguniang Bayan Member Municipality of Hagonoy Province of Davao del Sur Dear SB Member Paden: This refers to your letter regarding your compensation as appointed Sangguniang Bayan (SB) Member of Hagonoy, Davao del Sur Per your letter and its attachments, the Office of the Municipal Mayor became permanently vacant due to the untimely demise of Mayor Franco Magno Calida on June II, 2023. By virtue of automatic assumption, Vice Mayor Jesus S. Dureza assumed the position of Municipal Mayor but only took his oath on August 7, 2023. The members of the sanggunian also succeeded with the 1st ranking member elevating to the Office of the Vice Mayor, the 2nd ranking as 1st, the 3rd ranking as 2nd, and so on and so forth, thereby leaving the last ranking position vacant. Consequently, you were appointed by Provincial Govemor Yvonne Rona Cagas to the vacant position. You and now Vice Mayor Balindoa took oaths as SB member and Vice Mayor, respectively, on July 14, 2023, before the Provincial Govemor. Thereafter, you assumed the said date and even attended the sanggunian session on July 19, 2023. Premised from the foregoing, arose your queries, thus: I. When is the official assumption to the office of Hon. Jesus S. Dureza, Jr.? 2. With the assumption of the ISt ranking SB Member as Municipal Vice Mayor as a result of the assumption of Mayor Dureza, when will the vacancy in Sangguniang Bayan be declared? 3. When is the official date of your assumption per the presented facts, and subsequently, when will your compensation start? It is the position of the Municipal Accountant that you are not entitled to your compensation prior to the taking of the oath of Mayor Dureza. It is argued that there is a defect in the effectivity date of your assumption vis-å-vis the vacancy in the plantilla. Pertinent portion of which is herein quoted: "Accordingly, Mayor Jesus S. Dureza, Jr., took his oath of office as full pledge (sic) Mayor last August 7, 2023 by virtue of succession. Thus, it is on this date Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54



August 7, 2023 that Mayor Dureza can be compensated as Mayor with the rate equivalent to SG 27-1 per plantilla in the budget, taking consideration (sic) that assumption of office was issued simultaneously. Consequently, it is on the same date that the plantilla position for vice mayor, with the rate equivalent to SG 25- 01 , can be considered vacant. Hence, it is then the appointment of Hon. Michael John J. Balindoa, the former ISt rank SB member as Vice Mayor by virtue of succession, will result to (sic) the vacancy of sangguniang bayan plantilla position." Considering that the foregoing issues are interrelated, the same shall herein be taken and discussed together. It is this Department's opinion that the view proffered by the Municipal Accountant appears to be misplaced. Pursuant to Section 44 of the Local Govemment Code of 1991 (Republic Act No. 7160, hereinafter referred to as the Code), the vice mayor shall become the mayor if a permanent vacancy occurs in the lattets office. Said assumption of office is automatic or by operation of law and therefore needs no further overt act.l Accordingly, the ISt ranking sanggunian member shall assume the position of Vice Mayor, while subsequent vacancies shall be filled automatically by other sanggunian members according to their ranking and in accordance with Sec. 45 of the Code. In the instance case, while then-Vice Mayor Hon. Jesus S. Dureza, Jr., did not immediately take his oath as Mayor; the same is immaterial—precisely because the assumption of office should be automatic. The automatic succession as mandated by the Code is fundamentally designed in order to avoid a hiatus in the operation of the office. Stated differently, the succession to office as contemplated by the Code is not contingent upon the taking of an oath by the officials involved. Filling up of vacancies is of urgent nature in order not to compromise the delivery of basic services to the public. It is to be emphasized that while it is required that all elective officials, upon assumption to office, must subscribe to an oath, in cases of succession to a higher office, it is submitted that the taking anew of the oath should not be the reckoning date of the actual assumption to office as it would be susceptible to abuse—it would lead to an absurd situation wherein succession to office will be dependent on the discretion of the official when he/she will take his oath anew. Again, succession to office in case of vacancy is automatic or by operation of law. We are, however, of the view that Mayor Dureza, Jr. from the time of his assumption until August 6, 2023 is a de facto Mayor for failure to conform to some precedent requirement or condition — failure to take the oath. Be that as it may, Mayor Dureza, Jr. is still entitled to compensation because a de facto officer, who, in good faith has had possession of the office and has discharged the duties pertaining thereto, is legally entitled to the emoluments of the office2. The discrepancy being posited as regards your appointment as SB member cannot be imputed considering that the same was made pursuant to Sec. 45 of the Code. You 1 DILG Legal opinion No. 130 s. 2021 2 Arroyo vs. the Court Of Appeals and Brito, G.R. No. 202860, April IO, 2019 Page 2 of 2

merely performed your responsibility since you were already appointed by the govemor and accordingly took your oath. To reiterate, filling up of vacancy in the sanggunian is impressed with urgency so as not to deprive the public of their right to representation. Following the discussion above, it is this Departments view that your official assumption is July 14, 2023, it should not be July II, 2023 because your assumption to the office is not automatic, rather, your assumption to the office is due to appointment pursuant to Section 45(a)(2) of the Code3. Your compensation shall start on the day you assumed coupled with the actual seNices rendered. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: . ROMEO . BENITEZ Officer-in-Charge, OUSELLA OUSELLA/RPB/LLLS-RO/I Dir. ALEX C.
